title: Leo/need Chapter1 Episode5 School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wha—?! I don't recognize this school! How did we get here?
We were in our own school's courtyard just a moment ago!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I don't know... And it's eerily empty.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You hear that? Cicadas. You don't usually hear them at this time of the year, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I hear something else, too. Someone playing guitar, and...
singing?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I may be imagining it, but it sounds like Miku.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You mean, someone's playing a Miku song?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sounds like it. Let's try to find them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think the sound is coming from over there.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona and Shiho?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki... Ichika... What are you two doing here?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're...not sure how we got here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see. Sigh. I'm going to be late for work...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Um, I also suddenly ended up here somehow.
Then I ran into Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We don't know what's going on, but we heard singing, and decided to follow the sound.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We were thinking the same thing!
Let's go together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The singing was coming from this classroom.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-Hello? Is anybody here?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(This classroom seems familiar, as if I'd been here before.
Ah, that's right. I dreamt about meeting Miku here.)

There you are at last!
You sure kept me waiting.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: M-Miku?!
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's this supposed to be?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is this really Miku? No, it must be a projection, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would you like to shake hands to see if I'm real? Here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can...shake your hand?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's good to finally meet you in person, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can feel your hand! You're real!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I saw you in a dream, and you looked just like this!
I have so many questions!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Me too. First of all, what is this place?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This is SEKAI, another world.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome to your SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's a world created by your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: How can that be possible?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: SEKAI are molded by what's in people's hearts. Your feelings also weave together into songs here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sure some of the things you see here will seem familiar to you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I don't understand any of this.
If this is some kind of a joke...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait. What's my bass doing here?
I didn't take it out of its case...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
My guitar is here too!
It should be back in my room at home...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Look, there's a keyboard and drums too! 
It's as if someone set everything up for band practice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Speaking of which, I'd LOVE us to play together again!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why not? You're welcome to use the instruments.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Isn't that what you wanted too, Ichika?
To play as a band?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You're saying it's okay for us to play right here?
That's awesome! Let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: B-But... I promised a friend to meet her after school today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And I've got work. Besides, there's no song we'd all know well enough to play together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: There's one! That song we practiced together years ago!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes... I remember that one...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then let's play it! We all know it, and it's not difficult!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Plus, it's one of Miku's songs, so it's appropriate!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, it's something I sang?
I'd like to hear you play it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You hear that? How can you say no?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, aren't you up for it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well... I...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I want to try it. I think it'd be really nice to play
that song together again.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
See? Ichi wants to play too!
Shiho, Hona, don't make me beg you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, I'm leaving. How do I get out of this place?
Miku, you must know?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, of course. But I'm not telling you until after you've performed the song.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You got me curious and now I want to hear how you play it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Sigh* Well, if it's just one song.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
.....
It's been a long time, so I may not be able to play very well, but I'll try.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I can't believe this is happening.
We're really going to play together.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And if that wasn't incredible enough, we're going to perform in front of Miku.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's hear what you've got.
